verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://developer.navan.com/llms.txt, a structured Navan Developer Portal file that points agents at the MCP integration. The developer portal also documents agent-facing MCP usage with example natural-language queries. Missing for 10: evidence of how comprehensive the llms.txt content is (e.g., whether it covers the full API reference or offers an llms-full.txt or markdown doc variants), and independent corroboration of agents successfully consuming it.
